t: Forge Steel 2-Way splitting wedge features durable steel construction, and 170mm strike face diameter. Designed to reduce the effort needed when using an axe on its own, the log splitter is intended for use in conjunction with a sledgehammer or maul. Suitable for use when processing timber, the 1.6kg steel wedge features a 2-way design to effectively split both dry and damp logs. Ideal for users such as gardeners and landscapers, to enhance productivity during various wood splitting tasks.
b: For Use With Sledgehammer or Maul
